source.dataset: RSNA 2024 Lumbar Spine Degenerative Classification Challenge

input.template_paths: relative to input/; scripts/example.py prepare materializes a valid C001 manifest with absolute paths
input.identity_check: PatientName/birth date/address/accession/institution/physician/operator fields empty; no private tags. PatientID equals public dataset study ID.

presentation_changes: Markdown image references use repository-relative PNG paths.
Evidence image source_file values use the same repository-relative PNG paths.
HTML is regenerated by the unchanged production report renderer.
export.verify_only_note: This is a portable presentation export, not a transplanted tool run. Verify with scripts/example.py verify; full pipeline replay needs installed models.

limitations: Sagittal T2/STIR is represented as a T2-like input; conventional T2 contrast is not established by the CSV label.
Anatomical level coverage is unconfirmed; coordinate labels are not a geometric coverage validation.
Spatial correspondence between series requires review before fusion.
RSNA stenosis labels are not herniation morphology or clinical nerve-root ground truth.
Source is a pinned third-party Hugging Face mirror; upstream dataset conditions remain recorded in provenance.json.
Anatomical numbering and registration remain unreviewed.
All 20 formal branches remain indeterminate; root candidates are empty.
Herniation is binary and has no side, size, zone or morphology.
RSNA training case is a development example, not an independent model-quality benchmark.

model_terms.name: SpineNet
model_terms.note: Original noncommercial research terms cover source, weights and outputs; no relicensing implied.
